description: Build a CSV parser module with a function `parse_csv_line(line, delimiter=',')` that splits a CSV line handling quoted fields containing delimiters, and a helper `strip_quotes(field)` that removes surrounding quotes. Test with 'a,b,c' and '"quoted",unquoted,"has,comma"'.
